{{Quote|We have their location. We tracked their reconnaissance ship to the Ileenium system.|General Armitage [[Armitage Hux|Hux]], to [[Supreme Leader]] [[Snoke]]|<ref name="Episode VII">{{Film|VII}}</ref>}}
This '''recon pod''' was built by [[Jessika Pava]] in [[34 ABY]] for a reconnaissance mission on [[Starkiller Base]] following the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]]. To keep it small and undetectable, it did not contain [[engine]]s or weapons, only a scanner, [[life support]], communications, and a [[mag-field generator]] to help mask its signature even more.<ref name="Poe 27" />

For the mission the pod was towed into the [[star system]] by a [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]] [[pilot]]ed by [[Karé Kun]] and the pod was piloted by [[Temmin Wexley]], after finishing the scanning of Starkiller Base the pod was picked up by the [[X-wing starfighter|X-wing]] on the other side of the entry point.<ref name="Poe 27" />
